title: panicum jumentorum
intro: Panicum jumentorum, commonly known as Donkey Grass, is a tropical grass species native to tropical Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, exhibiting health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Panicum jumentorum include its potential use in treating various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
